title: Implement rootfs staging and manifest validation
purpose: Create a local staging validator that proves an Alpha rootfs contains the runtime manifest artifacts before image assembly.
scope: Add a validation script or deterministic command for the Alpha rootfs manifest.
Check existence, path, mode intent, hash availability, and no-secret policy where feasible on the host.
Emit structured evidence for later image factory and release provenance tasks.
deliverables: scripts or image helper for Alpha rootfs validation
acceptance_criteria: Validator fails closed when required runtime artifacts are missing.
Validator reports artifact IDs and paths in stable JSON.
Validator does not require external LLM or network access.
Validator does not stage generated rootfs outputs into git.
verification: Run the validator against a minimal fixture that passes.
Run the validator against a fixture missing policy or ModelBroker config and confirm failure.
Run git status --short and confirm generated outputs are not staged.
risk_notes: A non-failing validator is worse than no validator because it gives false promotion evidence.
implementation_steps: Choose the smallest validation surface that fits existing PowerShell tooling.
Add pass and fail fixture checks.
Record evidence under the Alpha workflow evidence directory.
failure_modes: Validator only checks directories but not required config files.
Validator emits free-form logs without machine-readable evidence.
Validator mutates source-controlled files during checks.
Validator passes when a required artifact is absent.

verification_matrix.command: Alpha rootfs validator against incomplete fixture
verification_matrix.expected: Non-zero exit or explicit failed status with missing artifact IDs
